description: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across India.
scheme_description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector scheme launched in February 2019 to provide financial assistance of Rs. 6,000 per annum to all landholding farmer families with cultivable land, subject to specified exclusion criteria, directly into their bank accounts via DBT.
target_beneficiaries: Landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names
current_application_cycle: Continuous Year-Round Registration / Triannual DBT (April-July, August-November, December-March)
next_expected_cycle: Continuous Year-Round Registration / 19th DBT Installment (December 2024 - March 2025)
application_status_evidence: Continuous 24x7 online New Farmer Registration is permanently open on pmkisan.gov.in and via CSCs with no annual cutoff deadline. Financial assistance of Rs. 6,000/year is disbursed in three equal 4-monthly installments (April-July, August-November, December-March). Installment release dates (such as the 18th installment disbursed on 5 October 2024 and 19th installment covering December 2024 - March 2025) represent payment disbursement events rather than application deadlines. Mandatory prerequisites for installment disbursement are Aadhaar e-KYC (OTP/biometric/face authentication), State Nodal Officer land record database validation (land seeding), and Aadhaar-seeded NPCI-mapped active bank accounts.

benefits.payment_frequency: Every 4 months (3 installments per financial year)
benefits.duration: Continuous benefit as long as eligibility criteria are maintained
non_financial_benefits: Direct access to Kisan Credit Card (KCC) linkage

All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000 or more (excluding MTS / Class IV / Group D employees)
All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying out practice

description: Credit-linked margin money subsidy scheme to generate self-employment by establishing micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
scheme_description: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) is a credit-linked subsidy programme administered by the Ministry of MSME to establish micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service/business sectors. Subsidies range from 15% to 35% of project cost, with maximum project cost of Rs. 50 Lakh (Manufacturing) and Rs. 20 Lakh (Service).
target_beneficiaries: Charitable Trusts setting up new micro-enterprises
current_application_cycle: Continuous Online Intake / Annual District Target Allocation via PMEGP e-Portal
next_expected_cycle: Continuous Online Intake / Implementing Agency Scorecard & Bank Credit Appraisal Cycles
application_status_evidence: The KVIC PMEGP e-portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal) and JanSamarth portal accept online applications continuously round the year without a fixed calendar closing deadline. However, application acceptance and Margin Money subsidy release are strictly governed by annual district-level physical and financial targets, implementing agency digital scorecard screening (replacing routine DLTFC pre-vetting under revised guidelines), independent commercial bank credit appraisal, and mandatory EDP training. Portal accessibility does not guarantee active target availability in a specific district, requiring real-time live portal and agency verification before credit decisions.

description: Collateral-free working capital micro-credit with 7% interest subsidy and digital cashback for urban street vendors.
scheme_description: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) was launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs to facilitate collateral-free working capital loans to street vendors in urban, peri-urban, and surrounding areas. Offers progressive tranches of Rs. 15,000 (1st), Rs. 25,000 (2nd), and Rs. 50,000 (3rd), 7% interest subsidy, and digital cashback up to Rs. 1,600/year. Extended by Union Cabinet through March 2030.
target_beneficiaries: Street vendors and hawkers vending in urban, peri-urban, and surrounding rural areas
current_application_cycle: Continuous Lending Window Extended Through 31 March 2030

Applications for fresh loans and 2nd/3rd tranches are accepted continuously online round the year on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in and via ULBs/CSCs without an individual submission deadline.

description: Voluntary and contributory pension scheme providing assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 after age 60 for unorganised workers.
scheme_description: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM) is a Central Sector pension scheme for unorganised workers whose monthly income is Rs. 15,000 or less and who enter between the ages of 18 and 40. On reaching 60, beneficiaries receive an assured minimum monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 with 50% spouse family pension. Centrally matched 50:50 monthly contribution (Rs. 55 to Rs. 200).
target_beneficiaries: Unorganised workers (home-based workers, street vendors, mid-day meal workers, head loaders, brick kiln workers, cobblers, domestic workers, rickshaw pullers, agricultural laborers, construction workers)
current_application_cycle: Continuous National Year-Round Enrolment via maandhan.in and CSCs
next_expected_cycle: Continuous Enrolment & Monthly Auto-Debit Contribution Cycles
application_status_evidence: The Maandhan national portal (maandhan.in) and nationwide CSC network (4+ lakh VLE centers) enroll unorganised workers continuously round the year with no calendar closing deadline. Eligible unorganised workers aged 18 to 40 with monthly income up to Rs. 15,000 make 50:50 matched monthly contributions (Rs. 55 to Rs. 200) until age 60, after which an assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 is disbursed for life. The 18-40 age window represents citizen entry eligibility rather than an application closing date.

description: Deposit-free LPG connection, free first refill, and free stove for eligible adult women from poor/deprived households.
scheme_description: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY / Ujjwala 2.0) is a flagship scheme by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas to provide clean cooking fuel (LPG) to women in poor households. Benefits include a deposit-free LPG connection (Rs. 1,600 government financial support for 14.2 kg connection), free first refill cylinder, and free gas hotplate/stove, plus targeted DBT refill subsidy of Rs. 300 per cylinder (up to 12 refills/year) extended through FY 2025-26.
target_beneficiaries: Adult women (age 18+) from poor/deprived households (SC, ST, PMAY-G, AAY, Forest Dwellers, MBC, Tea Garden tribes, Island dwellers, or households fulfilling 14-point declaration)
current_application_cycle: Cabinet Target Expansion (75 Lakh Connections / 10.35 Cr Total) through FY 2025-26
application_status_evidence: The Union Cabinet approved the expansion of PMUY to release 75 lakh additional deposit-free LPG connections (taking total target to 10.35 crore connections) over FY 2023-24 to FY 2025-26 with a financial outlay of Rs. 1,650 crore, alongside targeted cylinder refill subsidies. Online and distributor applications remain open without a fixed calendar closing deadline (application_deadline is null); however, actual connection release is strictly quota-dependent, governed by remaining district-level and distributor-level OMC quotas.
